subject: Re: Sat nav or no sat nav??
author: Xandu
body:
I love my TomTom (satnav). It was a birthday present. It always takes me the quickest route to where I want to go (as long as it is on the map 🙂). It has never taken me in the wrong direction. Also having Yoda telling me where to go is quite funny... "to the left you must go", "at your destination you have arrived" 😃. As for it being stolen... that would be a terrible loss! but since it is so small I normally never leave it in the car.

Apparently there will be some kind of navigation system in Burnout Paradise too... hmm hopefully it will be better than boot's satnav 🙂

-- The Creator --

subject: I think I'll pass
author: oO EezO Oo
body:
I was thinking of getting one for my dad once for a birthday present.  I was testing the waters to see if it would be something he would like and he went off.  "Ya know? I've never once in my life gotten in my vehicle and gotten myself so completely lost I couldn't find my way back home!  I'm here right now aren't I? What would I need one of those things for?"  Soooo that kinda settled it for me.  The Hudson map books are pretty convenient when you learn how to use 'em.  I can see the convenience of it all but I can think of a few other things I'd rather purchase.  Happy Takedowns.

" Ooh ooh ooh......VERTICAL.......sweeeeeeeeeeet! "

subject: Working Sat's
author: ZombieTron
body:
If people didn't work on the weekends when would I shop? I used to work Saturday mornings and get Wednesday afternoon off instead which I really liked cos the Cinema is cheaper on a Wednesday afternoon and the shops were pretty empty! 🙂

Weekend workers are essential, but it does help if you get the same days off as your other half.

Sat Navs are great! especially for trips to new places, it means you don't have to research what route you are going to take before hand so can save a lot of time. The last time we went away to see some friends their address was not on our Sat Nav as it is a new development, so that made it a little useless - you have to keep it updated.

Glad you are still blogging!
